description: Check whether a specific customer has Ford PRIVATE offers on a VIN — targeted incentives Ford assigns to individuals (owner loyalty, conquest, lease maturity, mailer certificates). Ford requires the customer's FULL identity: first name, last name, street address, city, state, and ZIP — collect all of these from the customer before calling; never guess or reuse another person's identity. Most shoppers have no private offer; an empty result is normal and public rebates (get_vehicle_rebates) may still apply. Only one private offer certificate can be applied per deal.
name: check_ford_private_offers
